Since 1880, THE LEAGUE OF
AMERICAN BICYCLISTS has been
people-powered, with a goal to make
bicycling safer and easier as a means
of transportation and recreation. Today,
the League continues to improve lives
and strengthen communities through
bicycling. We are more than 200,0000
members and supporters strong with
more than 1,000 state and local advo-
cacy groups and bike clubs, as well as
thousands of businesses, universities,
and communities together leading the
movement to create a Bicycle Friendly
America for everyone.
